ei.title: Why Two Reasons Are Worse Than One
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: My colleagues and I ran an experiment testing two different messages meant to convince thousands of resistant alumni to make a donation. One message emphasized the opportunity to do good: donating would benefit students, faculty, and staff. The other emphasized the opportunity to feel good: donors would enjoy the warm glow of giving. The two messages were equally effective: in both cases, 6.5 percent of the unwilling alumni ended up donating. Then we combined them, because two reasons are better than one. Except they weren't. When we put the two reasons together, the giving rate dropped below 3 percent. Each reason alone was more than twice as effective as the two combined. The audience was already skeptical. When we gave them different kinds of reasons to donate, we triggered their awareness that someone was trying to persuade them — and they shielded themselves against it.

questions.passage: My colleagues and I ran an experiment testing two different messages meant to convince thousands of resistant alumni to make a donation. One message emphasized the opportunity to do good: donating would benefit students, faculty, and staff. The other emphasized the opportunity to feel good: donors would enjoy the warm glow of giving. The two messages were equally effective: in both cases, 6.5 percent of the unwilling alumni ended up donating. Then we combined them, because two reasons are better than one. Except they weren't. When we put the two reasons together, the giving rate dropped below 3 percent. Each reason alone was more than twice as effective as the two combined. The audience was already skeptical. When we gave them different kinds of reasons to donate, we triggered their awareness that someone was trying to persuade them — and they shielded themselves against it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 설득 이유를 합치면 역효과가 난다는 요지
det.analysis:
✅ ① 이유를 합치면 설득 의도 간파되어 역효과: 글의 핵심 ← 정답
❌ ② 많을수록 효과적: 본문과 반대
❌ ③ 감정에 더 쉽게 설득: 두 메시지 모두 동일 효과였음
❌ ④ 기부 의무: 본문에 없음
det.tip: two reasons together → triggered skepticism → dropped

ch: 설득 이유를 여러 개 합치면 상대가 설득 의도를 알아채 오히려 역효과가 난다.
기부를 유도하는 메시지는 많을수록 더 효과적이다.
사람들은 돈보다 감정에 더 쉽게 설득된다.
졸업생은 모교에 반드시 기부할 의무가 있다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

두 개의 이유가 한 개보다 낫다.

[조건] (1) are, better, one, reasons, than, two 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.analysis:
본문: 'because two reasons are better than one' — 비교급 better than.
[조건 검증] two(1) reasons(2) are(3) better(4) than(5) one(6) = 6단어 ✅
det.tip: A is better than B = A가 B보다 낫다

questions.wa: two reasons are better than one
accept: two reasons are better than one
